title: ServiceNow - Moveworks AI - Manger
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Manager**
 As part of our EY GDS\-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using ServiceNow platform. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problem.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Lead Architect with expertise in ServiceNow Implementation and specifically Moveworks AI to join the EYD GDS ServiceNow. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
   

  

 The architect designs and owns the “AI front door” experience for employees, where Moveworks acts as the primary conversational layer over ServiceNow processes.
   

  

 Ensure natural language requests raised in Teams/Slack/Employee Centre are accurately translated into governed ServiceNow workflows.
   

  

**Key focus areas**
* Designing intent\-to\-action mappings between Moveworks AI Assistant and ServiceNow (ITSM, HRSD)
* Structuring knowledge bases, service catalog items, and record producers to be AI\-consumable
* Reducing ticket intake by enabling autonomous resolution for L1/L2 use cases (passwords, access, FAQs)


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Performs Configuration/Customization of the ServiceNow system, including creation workflows
* Architecting end\-to\-end AI agents that combine:
+ Moveworks Reasoning Engine
+ ServiceNow workflows, approvals, and policies

* Defining when the AI resolves fully vs. hands off to human agents
* Designing reusable agent patterns (HR)
* Performs integrations and process automation using Orchestration, Web Services, Soap calls, etc.
* Load, manipulate and maintain data between ServiceNow and other systems as needed
* Gathers specifications from the business departments and delivers a product/release that meets the needs presented. Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation
* Work with business liaison to generate dashboards, home pages, performance analytics data collectors and reports as needed
* Must analyse and fully understand user stories and internal procedures to improve system capabilities, automate process workflows and address scheduling limitations throughout the development and delivery of the ServiceNow releases
* Own Architectural reviews, quality reviews and technical documentation
* Performs system and integration testing with sample and live data


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep understanding of Moveworks AI Assistant \& Enterprise Search
* Experience designing conversational flows that replace portals/forms
* 
* Hands\-on experience with Moveworks–ServiceNow integration architecture
* Authentication protocols such as IAM/Active Directory / LDAP or SiteMinder federation /Azure
* Integrating with internal and external applications and systems
* JavaScript, HTML, Angular JS and good web design practices
* Implementation experience on any of the following applications on ITSM, HRSD, Service Portal, Agentic AI, Gen AI.
* Disciplined Agile Delivery software release build/deploy processes


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 10\+ years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* ServiceNow CSA certification is mandatory, CIS\-HRSD is favourable


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on SDLC or TFS or JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* Knowledge about ServiceNow’s latest version’s features.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1000\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY ServiceNow practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Team Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Team Lead to build and lead a team of software engineers developing a strategically important cloud\-based platform that enables customers to check and improve the accuracy of their X\-Rite color measurement devices.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role, combining hands\-on software development with technical leadership and people management. The role focuses on enabling team effectiveness, technical excellence, cloud\-native architecture, and continuous improvement in a global engineering environment.
   

  

 The team owns a modern web application built with TypeScript, React, Redux, HTML, CSS, AWS, Lambda, Node.js, and serverless technologies, as well as a companion Qt/C\+\+ desktop application responsible for collecting and managing data that is integrated into the cloud platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing team of software engineers
* Hire, onboard, motivate, and coach team members, fostering engagement, growth, and a strong team culture
* Contribute hands\-on to software development, including design, implementation, code reviews, and technical problem solving — leveraging AI throughout the software development lifecycle
* Provide technical leadership and guide architectural decisions for both the cloud platform and associated desktop applications in collaboration with global engineering teams (US, Switzerland, India, Germany, Netherlands, North Macedonia)
* Own and evolve scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud\-native architectures on AWS
* Drive the evolution of frontend and backend systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, usability, and security
* Collaborate closely with product management, UX, QA, data engineering, and application support teams to deliver customer value
* Facilitate Agile ways of working (Scrum/Kanban), supporting effective planning, execution, prioritization, and delivery
* Establish and continuously improve software engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, cloud operations, observability, security, and effective usage of AI
* Ensure seamless integration between cloud services and desktop applications that contribute data to the platform
* Work closely with global stakeholders across India, Europe, and the US to align technical direction with product strategy
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence


**Required Qualifications \& Professional Knowledge**
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering
* 3\+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
* Strong hands\-on experience building and maintaining modern web applications
* Several years of experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML, and CSS
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Experience designing and operating cloud\-native solutions on AWS or Azure
* Solid understanding of serverless architectures and services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and related cloud technologies
* Experience designing scalable distributed systems and defining application architectures
* Ability to analyze customer and business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions
* Experience establishing engineering best practices including testing strategies, CI/CD, code quality, monitoring, and security
* Solid understanding of modern web application architecture and software design principles
* Experience collaborating with UX, Product Management, QA, and other engineering disciplines
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global, cross\-functional teams
* Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle
* Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum and/or Kanban)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Willingness to travel (10%)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience leading teams developing cloud\-native SaaS or enterprise software platforms
* Experience with AWS services beyond Lambda and API Gateway, such as RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch
* Experience with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud automation
* Experience working with data\-intensive applications, analytics platforms, or data pipelines
* Experience working in geographically distributed teams


**Nice to Have**
* Knowledge of desktop software development using C\+\+ and Qt
* Experience integrating desktop, edge, or device\-connected applications with cloud services
* Knowledge of color management, measurement systems, or hardware\-connected software solutions


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* :5\+ years of experience delivering and evolving commercial software products throughout their lifecycle
* Experience balancing technical leadership, people leadership, and hands\-on software development responsibilities


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to balance hands\-on work with leadership responsibilities
* Passion for building high\-performing engineering teams and developing people
* Collaborative and pragmatic approach in a cross\-functional, global environment
* High learning agility and enthusiasm for modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies, and AI\-assisted development
* Ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in a fast\-paced environment
* Effective communicator capable of aligning stakeholders across multiple functions and regions


 Ability to operate effectively in a distributed team with partial timezone overlap (India ↔ US/EU)
   

  

 We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team.
   

  

**We Offer**
* A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment.
* Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field.
* A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model.
* A human\-sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R\&D department.
* Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career.
* The opportunity to work on business\-critical data platforms that support decision\-making across the company.
* Be part of building products that address real\-world challenges for customers across global industries. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions, and see your contributions create measurable business value.
* Direct collaboration with engineers, product managers, support teams, and business stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and North America.
* A culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenges.
* The freedom to contribute ideas, drive improvements, and influence technical direction.
* Team leads are trusted to contribute not only technical expertise, but also vision, coaching, and leadership that help shape the future of our products and organization.


 Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross\-functional teamwork sets us apart.
   

  

 At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
   

  

**Unsolicited Assistance**
 We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

title: SAP - Basis  Senior Associate
description:

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a SAP \- Basis Senior Associate, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions within an organization. You will be responsible for tasks such as installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality work. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of our Business Application Consulting group, specializing in SAP Technology. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will help clients optimize operational efficiency by analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. This opportunity allows you to leverage your skills in SAP technology to enable clients to achieve their strategic objectives within our Finance Technology \- SAP Core ERP practice.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyzing client needs to implement and support SAP software solutions effectively
* Managing the installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
* Developing and maintaining SAP systems to optimize operational efficiency for clients
* Providing training and support to clients for seamless integration and utilization of SAP applications
* Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for SAP development and customization
* Collaborating with teams to drive business transformation and process optimization initiatives
* Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities
* Engaging in strategic technology planning to align SAP solutions with client objectives
* Navigating complex situations to build meaningful client relationships and deliver quality outcomes
* Upholding professional and technical standards while interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications aligned to SAP Technology and platform solutions, including SAP S/4HANA System Administration, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, SAP Security, or related technical architecture credentials
* Demonstrating proficiency in SAP HANA and SAP NetWeaver
* Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for business transformation
* Excelling in strategic technology planning and process optimization
* Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud for data\-driven insights
* Embracing change and fostering innovation in complex environments
* Building meaningful client connections through effective communication and active listening

 Insurance

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**

* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion

* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)

title: Microsoft-F and O Functional-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics F\&SCM Senior Functional Manager:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Functional Architect – D365 Finance \& Supply Chain Management (F\&SCM) Senior Manager to lead enterprise\-wide ERP transformation programs and define functional strategy across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Operations domains. This role combines business transformation leadership, solution architecture, delivery governance, and people leadership to drive complex global implementations and deliver scalable, business\-focused outcomes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Define and govern enterprise\-level functional architecture for Dynamics 365 F\&SCM solutions across multiple programs.
* Lead large\-scale ERP transformation initiatives, aligning business objectives with industry\-leading practices and Microsoft solution capabilities.
* Drive end\-to\-end solution design across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Asset Management, and Project Operations domains.
* Partner with executive stakeholders to shape transformation roadmaps, operating models, and target\-state business processes.
* Provide leadership throughout solution envisioning, fit\-gap analysis, design, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
* Govern functional design quality, solution standards, risk management, compliance, and delivery excellence.
* Lead cross\-functional teams spanning functional, technical, integration, data migration, and testing workstreams.
* Drive program planning, resource management, budget oversight, and delivery governance across complex global engagements.
* Build, mentor, and develop high\-performing consulting teams while fostering innovation and continuous improvement.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal stakeholders on ERP strategy, business process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F\&SCM and AX 2012 across Finance and Supply Chain business processes.
* Strong understanding of enterprise business processes including Record\-to\-Report, Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Enterprise Asset Management, Manufacturing, and Inventory Management.
* Proven ability to define functional architecture strategy and lead large\-scale ERP transformation programs.
* Strong experience in business process re\-engineering, solution design, configuration, testing, and implementation.
* Knowledge of integrations, data migration, reporting, analytics, and enterprise application ecosystems.
* Experience managing global delivery teams and multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, executive communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Strategic problem\-solving, governance, risk management, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to build, mentor, and lead high\-performing functional consulting teams.
* Business\-focused mindset with a strong focus on value realization and transformation outcomes..


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI).
* Experience with Azure integration services and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with Agile, DevOps, and modern ERP delivery methodologies.
* Strong exposure to data migration, master data governance, and reporting frameworks.
* Functional certifications in Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management.
* Experience leading multi\-country or global ERP transformation programs.
* Using and authoring Copilot Studio Agents.


**What We Look For**
* 12\+ years of total and relevant experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F\&SCM and/or AX 2012 functional consulting, solution design, and implementation.
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience leading large ERP programs, practice teams, or consulting organizations.
* Proven track record of delivering multiple end\-to\-end D365 F\&SCM implementations.
* Experience in defining functional architecture, business transformation strategy, and governance frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage executive leadership and client sponsors.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, Technology, or a related field.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications preferred.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and client relationship management skills.
